label: Completion-gate topology is split-brain: validator gates AC only, completion tool gates tasks checklist only, and the two share zero enforcement code
claim: README:198 presents AC_COVERAGE and check-completion as linked gates; registry has 39 rules, none for completion/checklist
groundTruth: acceptance-criteria.md: gated inside validate.sh --strict (AC_CLOSURE error, AC_COVERAGE info) + used for level inference by completion-state.cjs:45; tasks.md P0/P1/P2 checklist: enforced only by check-completion.sh (the Completion Verification Rule, :48), consumed by the completion exposer (plugin system_speckit_completion -> completion-state.cjs:241) and the Stop-hook sentinel (:160-188) - validate.sh never runs it; a packet can pass --strict with an incomplete P0 checklist, and pass the exposer with unmet AC rows; checklist.md is dead, alive only in stale prose
recommendation: document the split explicitly (validator=AC closure; completion tool+Stop hook=tasks checklist) or merge by registering check-completion as a registry rule

direction: checklist.md is discovered or enforced anywhere in code

direction: validate.sh --strict enforces the tasks.md P0/P1/P2 checklist

answer: NOT three live surfaces - TWO live + one dead. acceptance-criteria.md: validator-gated (AC_CLOSURE error, AC_COVERAGE info) + completion-exposer level inference. tasks.md verification checklist: read ONLY by check-completion.sh (UNTAGGED blocks, P0/P1 need evidence), consumed by the completion exposer and the Stop-hook sentinel - outside the validator. checklist.md: dead - absent from SPEC_DOCUMENT_FILENAMES, the manifest, and check-completion.sh; alive only in stale prose. The validator reads neither the tasks checklist nor checklist.md; the exposer reads tasks.md (via check-completion.sh) and acceptance-criteria.md (via file presence).
